about: Size ladder of pure open-source imports (permissive licenses), pinned commits. size_kb is GitHub's reported repository size; the script measures the packed size, objects and commits of the pinned commit and writes them to its results. Optional rungs run only when named with --rungs.

rungs.name: svelte
rungs.measured: 118.8 MiB packed, 168,943 objects, 11,458 commits (7,025 first-parent), 13,129 tip files and trees, largest blob 18.3 MB (site/static/tutorial/music/strauss.mp3)
expect: Import: 8 pushes planned (--plan-only); strauss.mp3 (18.3 MB) streams in as a large file.
Full clone: served (no object cap); the first stores its pack, later ones stream it. Partial and shallow clones: served.
Search: the first query builds the index cold (tens of seconds); later ones served. Blame, history, Overview: served.

rungs.name: kubernetes
expect: Import: 40-60 pushes (about 1.5 GB / 40 MiB; objects likely over 1M / 30k), hours of pushing; a file over 100 MiB stops it.
Full and partial clone: served in waves, within 40,000 object-store reads (bundled) and 15 minutes: the first full clone is the one to watch.
Search: cold index build over many partitions may exceed a request's limits. Overview, blame, history: served; path history from the chain index.

rungs.name: material-design-icons
expect: Import: about 130+ pushes by bytes (5 GB / 40 MiB) but only 318 commits: single first-parent steps of tens of thousands of icon files are expected to exceed one push's 40,000 objects: the import is expected to break here first.
Clones: served in waves if imported; the 15-minute and read budgets are what to watch.
Search: directories of more than 200,000 files are not indexed (named as refused); Overview lists the whole tree but analyses at most 400 source files.

rungs.name: clickhouse
expect: Optional source-code rung over 5 GB (313k commits). Import: hundreds of pushes; same fetch caps as kubernetes; DO SQLite growth from 313k commits' records is the limit to watch.
